zh.intro: DeepSeek Gestalt 0.1.4 收录上一版本之后的 {{commitCount}} 个提交。

sections.heading: 模型与子代理
items: 具备能力的 subagent 调用可以按次指定 LLM provider 和 model；省略则继续继承主会话当前路由。

sections.heading: 搜索与桌面默认
items: Web Search 收成一张卡片，按提供方分页，并可移除官方 DeepSeek。
Desktop 默认 overlay 不再注入 time-context。

en.intro: DeepSeek Gestalt 0.1.4 contains the {{commitCount}} commits after the previous Desktop Bundle.

sections.heading: Models and subagents
items: A capable subagent call can set LLM provider and model per delegation; omitted fields still inherit the parent session route.

sections.heading: Search and Desktop defaults
items: Web Search is one card with provider tabs, and official DeepSeek can be removed.
The Desktop default overlay no longer injects time-context.
